newsitem.title: UK: Unichem says has 10.1 pct of Lloyds Chemists.
newsitem.headline: Unichem says has 10.1 pct of Lloyds Chemists.

text.p: British drugs wholesaler and retailer Unichem Plc said on Monday it had acceptances for 10.1 percent of Lloyds Chemists Plc's ordinary share capital under its bid for the company.
Unichem also said its offer for the pharmacy chain operator and wholesaler had been extended until 1500 GMT on January 17.
Unichem and German rival Gehe AG have both launched bids for Lloyds, which last month told investors to sit tight in the event that the bidders increase their offers.
Both companies have until January 17 to raise their bids.
Unichem said that as of Friday, the second closing date of its offer, it had received valid acceptances representing about 0.4 percent of Lloyds' ordinary shares.
Unichem previously held some 12.3 million ordinary shares, representing about 9.7 percent of Lloyds.
The value of Unichem's offer, which is composed of shares and cash, has fallen with Unichem's share price in recent weeks.
Gehe's offer is composed entirely of cash.
